overviewParagraphs: Dragon Golf Links near Hai Phong is one of the most authentic links-style golf experiences in Northern Vietnam. Positioned directly on the coast with the sea encroaching on multiple holes, the layout offers a wind-driven challenge that demands the full repertoire of creative shot-making that defines genuine links play.

Firm and fast playing conditions reward the low-running approach, and the natural coastal bunkering provides both visual drama and tactical consequence. The course changes character completely depending on wind direction, ensuring every visit feels like a fresh challenge even for returning players.

An excellent choice for the discerning golfer who wants a pure links experience in the north of Vietnam. Its coastal character, accessibility from Hanoi, and tactical depth make Dragon Golf Links a standout addition to any extended northern Vietnam golf itinerary.

curatorBriefHtml: Dragon Golf Links is a premier Par 72 championship layout in Hai Phong, Vietnam, crafted by Greg Norman (2023) and stretching to 6,950 Yards across a coastal dunes and seaside environment. In Asia Golf Specialists' (AGS) field evaluations, the course stands out for its peninsula ocean panorama & sea winds (Juts directly into Tonkin Gulf) and paspalum salt-tolerant turf conditioning (Lush green oceanfront carpet).

From an itinerary-engineering perspective, Dragon Golf Links (Resort & Visitor Access via AGS) requires advance flight allocation and experienced local caddie pairing—particularly during the peak Vietnam dry season. Our curatorial scorecard specifically notes its caddie wind reading & club selection (Navigates 2-to-3 club breezes), making pre-reserved morning tee times and private door-to-clubhouse VIP transfers essential for maintaining pace of play.

When integrated into a multi-round Hai Phong golf tour by AGS, Dragon Golf Links provides a distinct architectural test by Greg Norman that complements neighboring regional layouts while keeping daily hotel-to-tee transfer times streamlined.

faqs.q: What are the key course specifications for Dragon Golf Links?
faqs.a: Dragon Golf Links in Hai Phong, Vietnam is a Par 72 championship layout designed by Greg Norman (opened 2023), measuring 6,950 Yards within a coastal dunes and seaside setting. It is particularly noted for peninsula ocean panorama & sea winds (Juts directly into Tonkin Gulf).

faqs.q: How do I secure tee times and caddies at Dragon Golf Links?
faqs.a: Dragon Golf Links operates under resort & visitor access via ags protocols. Asia Golf Specialists secures guaranteed morning tee times, compulsory caddie and cart pairings (caddie wind reading & club selection (Navigates 2-to-3 club breezes)), and private VIP transfers from your Hai Phong hotel as part of a custom golf itinerary.

faqs.q: What playing conditions and turf can golfers expect at Dragon Golf Links?
faqs.a: Our field inspection highlights Dragon Golf Links's paspalum salt-tolerant turf conditioning (Lush green oceanfront carpet) alongside peninsula ocean panorama & sea winds (Juts directly into Tonkin Gulf). Standard championship golf attire (collared shirts, tailored trousers or shorts, and soft-spike golf shoes) is strictly enforced by the starter.

faqs.q: What is the best time of year to play Dragon Golf Links?
faqs.a: October through April suits the northern location of Dragon Golf Links.
